sloka: तं पुत्रवधसन्तप्तं निर्यान्तं राक्षसाधिपम्।बलेनावृत्य महता निहनिष्यामि दुर्जयम् ।। ६.९२.१७ ।।
transliteration: taṁ putravadhasantaptaṁ niryāntaṁ rākṣasādhipam।balenāvṛtya mahatā nihaniṣyāmi durjayam ।। 6.92.17 ।।

translations.english: 'On hearing of his son's death, the Rakshasa Lord will come forth with a huge army. Turning towards him I will put an end to him.'
